title: Afterimage Parade
generation_prompt: Original all-ages synthwave instrumental for a one-or-two-key electronic rhythm game at a STRICT constant 104 BPM in 4/4. No tempo drift, half-time breakdown, long percussion-free intro, free-time passage or smeared ambient-only middle. The signature hook is a six-note clipped analog-synth figure that repeats as an offset afterimage: the answer uses the same rhythm but a new descending contour and a warmer register. Support it with a gently pulsing rounded bass, bright offbeat chords, tiny syncopated bell sparks and spacious stereo delays without obscuring the attacks. At the midpoint change the harmony and introduce a brief two-note counter-melody over the same unbroken drum grid; in the finale layer the hook and its answer into a clear new cadence instead of duplicating the first half. One evolving 128-second stereo composition, upbeat and non-harsh. No vocals, speech, sampled recordings, known melody or imitation of an existing song.
